title: Bower Pack Sample Line
description: One line of a pack samples/*.jsonl file, version 2. Version 2 adds expectFields and parser names; every version 1 line (event or raw samples with decision, mustNotContain and expectedDetections) is a valid version 2 line. Editor support only: PackTester is authoritative and also rejects unknown or duplicated members, duplicate expectFields paths and expectations that name a pre-redaction value.

path.description: Dotted path into the redacted event: object member names, or zero-based array indexes. Segments are 1-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ $ @ -.

name.description: Shown in test output and reports. Defaults to sample-N.

expect.description: Expected decision. accept also passes for redact-and-accept; redact-and-accept requires redaction.

event.description: A semantic security event envelope. {{now}} is replaced with the current UTC time.

raw.description: A raw record for a pack parser (parse, transform, map, redact, select). {{now}} is replaced with the current UTC time, which is also the transform evaluation time.

parser.description: Parser for a raw sample: zero-based index in manifest (ordinal path) order, or a parser name (file name without extension, or its pack path).

mustNotContain.description: Strings that must not appear anywhere in the redacted event.

expectedDetections.description: Exact set of local detection rule ids expected on the redacted event.

expectFields.description: Post-redaction field assertions: path to "present", "absent" (missing or null) or an exact string, finite number or boolean. A string that equals a pre-redaction value missing from the redacted event, or contains a mustNotContain entry, fails without being printed.
